audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 holds: Ekko's kill plan runs through Phase Dive, the exact dash Vex's passive fear-interrupts; 53.1% WR over 1533 games; both layers agree Vex on all 7 chart rows.

Spikes sound: 3-5 fear-cancel window, level 6 W-stun-into-R answered by interrupting the E engage, first-item one-combo answered by Zhonya's/W shield, late flank-dive role. Packet's suspectName 'Phase Dives' is a false positive — it is the real ability used as a verb ('the moment he Phase Dives onto you').

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digit; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim. Two missing interactions now stated: Chronobreak heals a percentage of recent damage (Grievous Wounds timing matters when chasing) and Phase Dive's charged attack is an auto-reset whose wind-up, not cast, is the step-back cue.
audit.why: Riot kit: Chronobreak 110/80/50s heals for a percentage of damage received; Phase Dive is flagged autoReset at 9s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns added; bleed bodies replaced with title-matched, kit-grounded text.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak (R): 110/80/50s — erases your kill and bursts back; track the hologram, save final damage for after it. - Phase Dive (E): 9s — the roll charges an auto-reset; the wind-up is your cue to step back. W is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Phase Dive teleports him to whoever his charged auto targets — pulse as the wind-up starts and he arrives feared, his combo cancelled.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Chronobreak heals off the damage he just took — chasing a low Ekko with fear and W down hands him a rewind kill; anti-heal blunts it.

notes: Chart agrees across both layers (Vex on all 7 rows) — no chart edits. Packet suspectName 'Phase Dives' is the real ability name conjugated as a verb; no change made. Missing interactions (Chronobreak sustain / anti-heal timing, Phase Dive auto-reset tell) folded into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d. Packet defect (no cooldown-sequencing advice) addressed with Chronobreak 110/80/50s and Phase Dive 9s lines. Template-sweep note: tldr/enemyWin/ahead/breakdown.carry/late are the shared anti-assassin frame but are genuinely apt for Ekko (dash-reliant assassin); left unedited rather than churned.
